for: Quarterdeck merge build C-6, the ruling evidence on a Task Card
author: Quarterdeck contributors
how: Version 2 of evidence.json, written for the the ruling sweep: the same content with new pictures and a new video that show Search results with c1's new title ('Pick what a new device shows first'). The old file stays as it was.

Paths are relative to this file's folder: the media are in evidence/media, shot from our own local page evidence/pages/search.html with Playwright 1.64.1 (evidence/shoot-evidence.mjs, B's dark colours as the first version); nothing was fetched from outside. Only the page's c1 title changed, so the target picture and the eight fixture pictures are byte-identical to the first shoot.
media: pictures and videos, in the order the card shows them. A 'build' picture names its 'target'; they show side by side, and the viewer's 'Show target' switches to it.

links: preview links and delivered live services, each with a small screenshot ('shot'), its time ('updatedAt' for a preview, 'deliveredAt' for a live service) and, for a live service, 'status' (up or down) as of 'statusAt'.

check: the bot that checked the work and each check's result. The line reads 'Checked by Shelvorn: 3 of 3 checks pass'. A check counts only when 'by' is not 'doneBy' (the bot that did the work); see evidence-fixtures.json EV-6.

The Page link ('See all N on Page') follows the card's pageRefs[0] and shows only when that Page has a file (spec 4.3). alba-1's Page PG-2 has no file in the example data, so the card shows its 5 items and no 'See all'; EV-1 in the fixtures tests 'See all'.
URLs are example.com addresses: shown, never opened by the build's tests. Preview links are 'gated': until the gated Pages host exists they open in the browser (the ruling consequences).

The video is VP9 WebM (Playwright's own recorder; no other encoder on this machine). Safari plays WebM only on recent iOS and macOS; if the builder needs MP4, that is a new file from the content owner, never made by the builder.
Bot names in 'by', 'doneBy' and check 'by' are display names (bots[].name in the example data).
